clips.title: The story
paras: In Durotar, Burning Blade cultists corrupt the land from Thunder Ridge. Orgnil Soulscar in Razor Hill has learned that the goblin warlock Fizzle Darkstorm leads them, and asks you to end his threat.

Orgnil Soulscar has learned that dark magic has taken hold in Thunder Ridge, northwest of Razor Hill. Burning Blade cultists prowl the ravine while young Horde defenders patrol Durotar’s borders. Their presence brings ruin to the wildlife and land.

Fizzle Darkstorm, a goblin warlock allied with the Burning Blade, directs the cultists in Thunder Ridge. He wields fel power for the cult rather than serving commerce or cartel interests. Slaying him and bringing back his twisted claw will show Orgnil that the cult’s leaders in the ravine have been struck down.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We cannot allow the Burning Blade a foothold in Durotar! We must destroy them before their evil festers!

I have undergone my own investigations and found that a Burning Blade warlock, the goblin Fizzle Darkstorm, has camped within Thunder Ridge to the northwest. There he and his cultist minions spread chaos.
Find and defeat Fizzle, and bring me his dead claw!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you find Fizzle, friend? He, and rest of the Burning Blade, must be scoured from our lands!

clips.title: Completion
paras: You do your clan proud, friend. And because of you, Durotar is free of one more agent of evil.
